tables.name: Hjartheland Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Hjartheland settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Scandinavian / Old Norse inspired: traditional, sturdy and geographically meaningful.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Nordvik, Eirheim, Steindal.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: A founder's name joined directly to an ending, without a possessive s, e.g. Eirikheim, Signevik.
